# GitHub alerts

> [!NOTE]
> Useful information that users should know, even when skimming.

> [!TIP]
> Helpful advice for doing things better or more easily.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Key information users need to know to achieve their goal.

> [!WARNING]
> Urgent info that needs immediate user attention to avoid problems.

> [!CAUTION]
> Advises about risks or negative outcomes of certain actions.

A multi-line alert, with **emphasis** and `code` inside it:

> [!TIP]
> The first line is the marker.
> The rest is ordinary markdown, so **bold** and `code` still work.
>
> Even a second paragraph.

Lower case is accepted by GitHub too:

> [!note]
> Written in lower case.

These are not alerts and must stay as plain quotes:

> A plain blockquote with no marker.

> [!UNKNOWN]
> Not one of the five kinds.

> Text before the marker, so [!NOTE] is not a marker at all.
